integrity: Proof gives the Gaussian cosine Beta probability and the condition-number scaling analytically. Reproducible finite checks supplement but do not replace the proof. Classical Wishart/Beta facts and fixed-direction Gaussian-product probability laws are credited, not represented as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-Gaussian, one-dimensional sketched harmonic extraction on a fixed two-eigenmode plane; uniform in plane directions under one shared sketch. No assertion of complete restarted-algorithm convergence, complex/structured sketches, nonnormal operators, finite precision, or a uniformly safe ambient space of dimension greater than two.
title: An exact Gaussian positivity threshold for two-mode sketched harmonic Ritz extraction
